strings.name: Stewart Butterfield
strings.role: Flickr and Slack cofounder; former Slack CEO
strings.summary: Canadian entrepreneur Stewart Butterfield cofounded Flickr and Slack, advancing photo sharing and team communication. Trained in philosophy, he built products with cofounders and teams. After leaving Slack management, he continued philanthropic work and product discussions.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Testing and commercial launch, acquisition announcement and completion, and departure announcement and handover are distinguished. Philanthropic pledges retain joint attribution; a 2026 memoir does not date its events to 2026.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Flickr and Slack, advancing online photo sharing and instant team collaboration tools.
strings.facts.f1.label: Philosophy education
strings.facts.f1.value: University of Victoria philosophy bachelor’s in 1996, followed by a Cambridge MPhil; the master’s is not a doctorate.
strings.facts.f2.label: Joint founding
strings.facts.f2.value: Cofounded Flickr with Caterina Fake; Slack’s products and business also depended on cofounders and teams.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Photo sharing and collaboration
strings.highlights.h1.text: Flickr developed a photo community; Slack brought team conversations and work information together. Organizational results are not individual inventions.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Philanthropy and product thinking
strings.highlights.h2.text: After stepping down, discussed products and joined Jennifer Rubio in a foundation pledge supporting paid museum internships.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Joint support for museum internships
strings.timeline.t1.text: The Met announces their foundation pledge of over $23 million to endow an existing paid internship program.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Product interview published
strings.timeline.t2.text: Lenny’s Podcast releases his conversation on products and leadership; publication date, not a verified recording date.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Slack CEO handover
strings.timeline.t3.text: Lidiane Jones succeeds him; December 2022 announced a planned departure, not an exact effective date.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Salesforce completes Slack acquisition
strings.timeline.t4.text: Company announces completion, distinct from the 2020 agreement; transaction value is not personal proceeds.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Slack lists directly in New York
strings.timeline.t5.text: Company filing confirms Class A shares directly listed on NYSE, distinct from a traditional underwritten fundraising IPO.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Paid Slack launches
strings.timeline.t6.text: Early employee recollection records commercial launch, separate from earlier testing and company formation.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Yahoo acquires Flickr
strings.timeline.t7.text: Platform history records the acquisition of the photo-sharing business, built by cofounders and teams.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Flickr public beta released
strings.timeline.t8.text: Photo tool developed from a game project opens to the public at the O’Reilly Emerging Tech conference.
